Description: Step-by-step procedure to build an AND filter chain on the Change Request list page.

- Select the first field from the condition chooser combobox (e.g., 'Type').
- Set the field value by either clicking the option in the dropdown or using select_option on the combobox.
- Add subsequent AND conditions by clicking the 'Add AND Condition To Condition X' button.
- For each new condition, open the field chooser, select the desired field (e.g., 'Requested by', 'Model', 'Short description'), and set the value.
- For empty string filters, select the 'is empty string' option from the operator combobox.
- Continue adding conditions until all criteria (Type, Requested by, Model, Short description, State) are defined.
- The filter chain must be built entirely within the 'All of these conditions must be met' group.
